gen-dafont-redux-gf-readex-pro: Contemporary and geometric, Redux spaces its letters out with gentle stroke contrast. Readex Pro, a sans-serif body, holds every stem and arch at one thickness, so paragraphs run smooth and unhurried, with open terminals keeping each word easy to pick out.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-roboto: Contemporary through and through, Redux enters each curve with a visible flourish and keeps its crossbars slightly finer than its stems. And Roboto, the sans-serif body, simply gets on with it, with generous round letters and capitals that sit close to the lowercase in height.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-saira: Redux's wide spacing and showy entrance into every curve announce it right away. Saira, the sans-serif body, does the quieter job, with see-through s shapes and rounded letters stretching tall, while the heading keeps just a modest swell in its strokes.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-sofia-sans-semi-cond: Wide, geometric display on top, signage-plain text below. Redux hints at thick and thin in each glyph, while Sofia Sans Semi Condensed, a sans-serif body, holds lowercase nearly to capital height, and that contrast is the strongest thing about the pair.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-sono: Redux makes its mark with generously spaced letters and a visible swoop into every curve, with medium stroke contrast beneath. Sono, a sans-serif body, has tall lowercase and open a shapes; try the heading noticeably larger.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch is the body, built like rod stock throughout. Redux above it carries a faint nib-pressure swell in each round letter, and that gap between a living line and a constant one is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-sulphur-point: Sulphur Point brings wirelike strokes of one thickness and bulky lowercase, with open gaps in its rounds. And Redux, wide and geometric with crossbars a touch thinner than its stems, stretches out above it, giving the page a roomy, confident top and a compact, steady body.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-tiktok-sans: Wide, modern, and quietly geometric. Redux gives a mild thick-and-thin rhythm in its roomy display letters, while TikTok Sans, a sans-serif body, lifts its lowercase close to cap height, and that tall, spacious text is the pair's real draw.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-ubuntu-sans: Modern and contemporary, Redux swells moderately across its wide-set letters. Ubuntu Sans, a sans body of tubular strokes with no thick-thin shift, has big lowercase eyes, and that bent-pipe sturdiness against the heading's gentle swelling is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-yaldevi: Wide, geometric, and quick to catch the eye. Yaldevi, a sans-serif body with oversized lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right, carries paragraphs easily beneath Redux and its closely matched stems and hairlines.
